title: •I Wonder Who They Found
caption: •I Wonder Who They Found (V)
game_text: Use 2 Force to deploy on Han or Back Door; draw top card of Used Pile. Non-Jedi, non-{lightsaber} Rebels are defense value +2 and immune to attrition < 3. May place this Effect out of play to cancel the targeting of a weapon at same or related site.
lore: ‘General Solo, is your strike team assembled?’
copyright: © LUCASFILM LTD. & TM. TM, ® & © 1999 DECIPHER INC.
notes: Unique (•). Banner EFFECT, no grabber box. Inline icon after 'non-' is the black square with a green diagonal blade → {lightsaber} per the helper brief (Rev 8 calls this the Permanent Weapon icon — 'non-[permanent weapon] Rebels'). SLIP DIFFERS FROM STUB: the stub reads the icon as Rebel and writes 'non-Rebel characters'; the slip prints 'non-[icon] Rebels'. Lore corrected from scan: curly single quotes ‘…’ (wiki straight). Base scan only at 350 px; copyright not legible, Endor convention used. Modern: Virtual Block 3 only (VB3 -pre, 350 px).
